description: Expanded rule-based device classification: covers Apple/Samsung/Google phones+wearables, OnePlus/Xiaomi/Oppo/Vivo/Huawei/Honor/Motorola/Nokia/Realme, trackers (AirTag/Tile), wearables (Garmin/Polar/Suunto/WHOOP/Oura/Amazfit), streaming sticks (Roku/Apple TV 4K/Nvidia Shield/Fire TV Cube/Chromecast), TVs by brand (Vizio/Hisense/Philips/Sharp/TCL/Roku TV), consoles (Xbox Series/PS5/Quest), mesh routers (eero/Velop/Deco/Orbi/Nest WiFi/AmpliFi/AiMesh), lighting (Hue/LIFX/Nanoleaf/Govee/Kasa), vacuums (Roomba/Roborock/Eufy/Shark/Ecovacs), locks (August/Yale/Schlage/Level), hubs (SmartThings/Hubitat/HA/Aqara/Lutron), cameras (Blink/Ezviz/Tapo/Lorex/Swann/SimpliSafe/Vivint/ADT/Axis/Bosch), printers (Lexmark/Kyocera/Ricoh/Konica/OKI), VoIP (3CX/Grandstream/RingCentral/Vonage), POS (Toast/Clover/SumUp/Stripe/Lightspeed), vehicles (Ford/Toyota/Honda/Hyundai/Kia/Audi/VW/Volvo/Mercedes/Nissan/Polestar/Rivian), Pi-hole/RPi, hardware wallets.
